title: Cost Harmonizer: predictive throttle, safe-apply fallback and incident appendix
creator: Asha Patel
description: This ticket consolidates the incident follow-up, mitigation playbook, and safe-apply/rollback checklist for the new Cost Harmonizer tuning agent. The Cost Harmonizer is a predictive coordinator that converts Optimize's recommendations (batching and KV caching profiles) into staged apply plans including dynamic throttles and simulated dry-runs. During a recent production run we observed an over-assertive apply that increased tail-latency under a correlated traffic surge. This document captures the retrospective, the deterministic repro harness (chaos simulation), concrete mitigations (predictive throttle, hysteresis, and staged validation), and an operator-focused rollback/runbook for fast recovery.
postmortem_summary: Root cause: recommendation scoring model failed to account for temporal correlation across customer routes, producing aggressive batching and cache warming that briefly overloaded the fronting FTL pool during a multi-region marketing surge. Probable contributing factors: missing inter-route dependency feature in the recommender, lack of simulation for correlated spikes, and a manual override applied without enabling dry-run validation. Impact: 8 minutes of elevated P95 latency for 3 enterprise tenants; no data loss. Detection: console alert on P95 and a sudden increase in CPU steal on nodes. Recovery: rapid rollback using the staged-apply abort and emergency throttle, manual cache coldness mitigation, and reversion to the previous quantization profile for affected model variants.

steps_taken: Immediate: Abort staged apply via /api/optimize/v1/apply/abort and enable emergency throttle profile (throttle: 30% per-route batching reduction).
Immediate: Revert to previous KV cache fill strategy for affected model variants and re-enable force-cold-warmup guard.
Short-term: Run deterministic chaos simulation reproducing correlated spike across N routes with historical traffic pattern; validated reproduce in sim-run-2026-03-12.
Medium-term: Implemented predictive throttle coordinator that derives a safe apply rate from a surge probability estimate and current cluster headroom metrics.
Medium-term: Added inter-route correlation feature to recommendation model and retrained with Q4-Q1 traffic data.
Long-term: CI gate for autotune includes a 5-minute chaos spike test and dry-run validation that measures tail latency and CPU steal against thresholds before rollout.
Documentation: Updated Console runbook and Optimize docs with emergency rollback commands and cost impact reports template.
mitigations_and_playbook: Predictive Throttle: new module that sets per-apply concurrency cap based on 90th percentile surge probability and current node spare capacity.
Hysteresis Windows: require at least 3 sustained safe-window reports (5m each) before increasing batching beyond prior max.
Dry-run Simulation: mandatory dry-run for >P1 recommendation changes that simulates correlated route traffic in a sandbox and measures P95 and CPU steal.
Canary Cohort Minimum: reduce canary cohort ceiling to 5% for cross-region or multi-tenant recommendations until 24h safe-window observed.
Manual Approval Gate: require PM or SRE sign-off for applies that change both batching and KV-cache strategies simultaneously for the same model family.
Automated Rollback: if P95 exceeds threshold or CPU steal > 15% for 3 consecutive minutes during an apply, autoscaler triggers immediate rollback and notifies SRE on-call.
rollback_checklist: 1) Stop apply: POST /api/optimize/v1/apply/abort {apply_id} and confirm status = aborted in response.
3) Restore KV strategy: patch model-config to previous_kv_fill_strategy and restart warmup-job for affected pool.
4) Validate node health: verify node CPU steal < 5%, load < 70%, and GPU utilization normal. Command: infra-monitor nodes --filter affected_pool.
5) Re-run lightweight smoke test: run sim-smoke on affected routes for 2 minutes; verify P95 < 250ms.
6) Postmortem: create postmortem with timeline, root cause, and learnings within 72 hours.
